findings.summary: MVP7-IMPLEMENTER-EXACT-EVIDENCE and MVP7-POST-BUILD-CRITIQUE are not present on the control/v0-mvp7-independent-handoff-r1 branch this review was based on; they live on origin/control/v0-mvp7-pc0-ad48-r1 (commit e2512db7a). The files were retrieved and reviewed from that ref; content binds the exact frozen subject.

MVP7-PRODUCT-EVIDENCE records only attempts 1-2 of run 35447331651; the authoritative fresh rerun (attempt 3, job 105977766107) is recorded only in MVP7-FRESH-MACHINE-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE on the pc0 control branch. All three attempts were independently verified via GitHub metadata; no substitution occurred.

v0_mvp7_reconnect_client.gd and v0_mvp7_reconnect_gateway_process.gd have no committed .uid sidecar files while other new scripts do. Cosmetic; CI exact-subject fence and clean tracked checkout checks passed.

Server/world restart and live ENet reconnect are proven as separate exact-head executions, not one simultaneous mid-session server-kill scenario. This boundary is explicitly declared in the evidence map and deferred to the MVP8 workload contract; it is not a hidden claim.

rank_up_moves: Consolidate all four MVP7 evidence documents plus the fresh-rerun machine-verifier record onto a single control branch (or the handoff branch) so a fresh Reviewer/Verifier finds the complete package at one durable locator.
Commit .uid sidecars for the two new MVP7 scripts to keep the tree consistent with the other new scripts.
For MVP8, compose the restart and live reconnect into one connected bounded-workload scenario (mid-session server kill with live clients) as already planned.
risk_assessment: LOW. No P0/P1 found in the bounded diff (24 paths, +2227/-0). Canonical ownership, quiescent checkpoint fencing, preflight-before-mutation recovery ordering, replay dedup, auth/epoch invalidation, and delivery-bound FINISH are all enforced in source and exercised by real multi-process evidence whose GitHub metadata, artifact digests and primary JSON contents were independently re-verified (gh CLI + artifact download). Residual risk is confined to the declared boundary: quiescent-checkpoint failure model (no arbitrary power-loss claim) and restart/reconnect proven on separate surfaces until MVP8.
